text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho is here. Gold
City is so
focused, I hesitate to get her
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This time, for sure, she'll get the
recognition she
so desires. She heads out
to the racecourse with
purpose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
